# Homelab Atlas

Homelab Atlas is a public catalog and safety guide for the self-hosted applications defined in the bolens/homelab repository. Each application page summarizes purpose, access, dependencies, persistence, and elevated runtime requirements; the repository remains the source of truth for deployment.

## Documentation

- Home: https://bolens.github.io/homelab/
- Application catalog: https://bolens.github.io/homelab/apps/
- Architecture: https://bolens.github.io/homelab/architecture/
- Safety guide: https://bolens.github.io/homelab/safety/
- Interactive topology: https://bolens.github.io/homelab/topology.html

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/bolens/homelab
- Getting started: https://github.com/bolens/homelab/blob/main/documents/GETTING-STARTED.md
- Stack definitions: https://github.com/bolens/homelab/tree/main/stacks
